title: Skirmish on Takodana
description: Rey, Finn, and BB-8 were taken to Maz Kanata's castle on planet Takodana by a rightfully concerned Han Solo. But before long the First Order, tipped off by spies, zeroed in and leveled this popular establishment, killing many and sending Solo and his allies into the nearby woods. A sudden counterattack by X-wing fighters led by Poe Dameron forced back the First Order TIEs...but not before Kylo Ren took Rey captive, realizing that she had seen the map all parties were searching for.
